# P05 · PWA shell, judge mode, check entry, error cards — tasks

**Goal (3 lines):** An installable, offline-first PWA in three languages: judge mode (role switcher, simulated banner, test script), teacher Home (T1), manual check entry (T2) with on-device diagnosis, error cards (T3), counts-only sync, phone frame on desktop.
Teacher numbers are counts, never percentages; simulated data is labelled; per-child answers never leave the phone.
Bundle under 1 MB compressed (warn above 400 KB), Lighthouse and screenshots as evidence.

**Read:** BUILD_PROMPTS P05; design §Screens by role, §Low connectivity; CLAUDE.md §4 (5, 6), §9, §11.

**Starting commit:** `6306eb7` · **Started:** 2026-10-17

## Tasks

- [x] **T01 · Design system** — `docs/design-system.md`: tokens, type roles, spacing, component rules, the AI-look check.
- [x] **T02 · i18n** — `src/i18n/{en,hi,ta}.json`, typed keys, fallback logged, CSV export/import script, i18n-todo generated. Test: English completeness, key parity.
- [x] **T03 · Engine keys carry the problem; counts-only API** — `a`,`b` per item in answer keys; `POST /api/classes/{id}/profile` rejecting per-child data; `GET /api/demo/block`. Tests: API rejects arrays and roll numbers.
- [x] **T04 · Client core** — Dexie tables, hash router, online/offline state with forced-offline, sync queue. Tests: payload has no per-child fields.
- [x] **T05 · Shell and J1** — phone frame, role switcher, language switcher, simulated banner, judge test script, Advance to Term 2, Simulate offline, links.
- [x] **T06 · T1 Home and T2 check entry** — manual grid with keypad, blank and unreadable, autosave, on-device diagnosis.
- [x] **T07 · T3 error cards** — counts text, example from her own answers, untracked note, audio button, flag. Test: never a percentage.
- [x] **T08 · PWA offline** — Workbox precache, manifest, installable. Playwright: judge → teacher → 10-child check → T3, then offline.
- [x] **T09 · Bundle budget** — script and CI step.
- [x] **T10 · Evidence and docs** — Lighthouse, screenshots en/hi/ta, `docs/offline.md`.

Evidence for every task: commits `5cbe187`..this report, and `docs/build/reports/P05-pwa-shell-check-cards.md`; `python tasks.py check` green, `python tasks.py e2e` 9 passed.

## v3 carry-over (added 2026-10-19, from `docs/build/reports/MIGRATION-v1-v3.md`)

Kit v3 rewrote this phase (flow engine, adapters, PWA step components). The v1 build below is the base and is kept; these tasks are new and PROGRESS shows P05 as reopened. Read the v3 P05 in `BUILD_PROMPTS.md` first. **Blocked on the Telegram bot token (Gopi).**

- [ ] **V3-T01 · Flow engine** `services/api/flows/`: versioned state machine; step types message, choice, photo_batch, number_grid, voice, media, link; never imports a channel. Test first: transitions per step type.
- [ ] **V3-T02 · Adapter contract and three adapters** `render(step)` and `parse(event)`; `telegram/` (python-telegram-bot >= 21, webhook secret in production, polling locally), `pwa/` (`GET /api/flow/current`, `POST /api/flow/answer`, idempotency keys), `whatsapp/` stub. Test first: contract tests for all three.
- [ ] **V3-T03 · Golden-transcript harness** every flow scripted once, run through Telegram (mocked) and PWA adapters, same steps and same stored state. Test first: the harness with onboarding and T1.
- [ ] **V3-T04 · Import rule** `services/api/channels/` and `apps/pwa/` import nothing from `engine/` or `ai/` (a test or import-linter). Test first: the rule fails on a planted import.
- [ ] **V3-T05 · Identity, consent, linking, delete** one pseudonymous teacher id; one-time linking code; one consent text; `/stop` and "Delete my data" clear both channels. Test first: cross-channel linking and deletion.
- [ ] **V3-T06 · Shared strings** move `apps/pwa/src/i18n/*.json` to `strings/{en,hi,ta}.json` used by the adapters and the PWA; keep missing-key logging and the CSV export. Test first: key completeness reads `strings/`.
- [ ] **V3-T07 · PWA step components** one per step type; photo batch with the IndexedDB outbox (downscale about 1200 px, JPEG 0.7) and ordered replay; `/r/<token>` opens the Practice Class; `POST /api/practice/link`. Test first: outbox replays in order with idempotency keys.
- [ ] **V3-T08 · Dexie down to allowed stores** after the photo flow can replace it (P08): remove `checks`, `profiles`, `syncQueue`; keep `transcripts`, `outbox`, `settings`. The v1 manual check entry stays as the interim typed fallback until then. Test first: a schema test listing the allowed stores.
- [ ] **V3-T09 · Judge mode** teacher role runs the real flows on simulated data; "Try it in Telegram: /start judge" with a QR code. Bundle budget with officer and judge routes code-split.
- [ ] **V3-T10 · Docs** `docs/architecture.md` (one back end, three adapters, mermaid), `docs/channels.md` (how to add a channel), `docs/offline.md` update.
